title: Fast Multidimensional Partial Fourier Transform with Automatic Hyperparameter Selection

problem.claim: Optimize computation of a selected part of Fourier coefficients for a multidimensional array.

gap.claim: Existing partial Fourier transform methods have difficulty handling multidimensional data efficiently and require manual hyperparameter tuning.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Pre-computation techniques within the partial Fourier transform algorithm have shown promising performance.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper addresses efficient computation of partial Fourier coefficients for multidimensional arrays.
Discrete Fourier transform supports various data mining tasks, and recent work targets efficient computation of small coefficient subsets using energy compaction.
Pre-computation techniques in partial Fourier transform have shown promising performance.
Partial Fourier transform remains inefficient for multidimensional data and requires manual hyperparameter tuning.
